List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture; Finance; Heavy

Total number of questions — 20
51
Reduction in Government equity in
Public Sector Banks
†*161. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Chairman,
Economic Advisory Council to Prime
Minister has advised to reduce Government
equity in Public Sector Banks in the
country to less than 51 per cent;
(b) if so, the details in this regard and
the reaction of Government in respect of
this advice; and
(c) the share of Indian and Foreign
investors' equity in each Public Sector Bank
till the end of September, 2007?
Disparity in per capita income
*162. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) what is the per capita income per
month in the rural and urban India;
(b) whether it is a fact that there is a
wide gap in the per capita income between
the urban and rural India;
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(d) what measures are being taken to
remove this disparity?
Expansion of air services in Madhya
Pradesh
†*163. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State
Government of Madhya Pradesh has
submitted proposals to the Central
Government on 26th May and 6th
December, 2006 for expansion of air
services in the State;
(b) whether these proposals have been
considered seriously and the results thereof;
(c) the details of proposals which are
likely to be considered;
(d) by when the project for upgrading
Khajuraho, Bhopal and Indore airports to
international level would be completed; and
(e) the reasons for delay in this regard?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

52
National Culture Policy
*164. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a Committee was
constituted by her Ministry in October last
year with the responsibility of making
recommendations to the Ministry for
framing a National Culture Policy and was
asked to study, among other things, the
extent and role of Government in various
areas of culture and also to assess the
mandate for various cultural institutions;
(b) if so, by what time the Committee
was asked to submit its recommendations;
(c) whether Government has received
the report; and
(d) if so, the details of the same?
Central grant for saline
embankments in Orissa
*165. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Orissa has requested the Centre for grant
of Rs. 750 crore flood aid to meet the losses
caused by the recent floods;
(b) whether the State Government of
Orissa has also approached the Centre for
financial assistance for construction of
saline embankments on the entire coastline
and dredging in the river mouths etc.; and
(c) if so, the details thereof, inter-alia
indicating the help that has so far been
provided to the State for the purpose?
Development of pilot training
institutes in the country
†*166. SHRI PYARELAL KHANDEL-
WAL: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of pilot training  institutes
(public and private) in the country;
(b) whether it is a fact that paucity of
such institutes leads to Indian youths having
to spend a fortune on getting the said
training abroad;
(c) if so, the details of the steps
Government is going to take to tackle this
problem;
(d) whether Government is mulling over
any plan to introduce these institutes at
various airports of Madhya Pradesh; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Production of cars
*167. SHRIMATI JAYA
BACHCHAN: Will the Minister of
HEAVY INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) the current production of cars in the
country, with details of the last three years;
(b) the details of new tie-ups in the next
few years;
(c) whether it is a fact that road
infrastructure available in the country does
not permit production of more cars; and
(d) if so, whether Government is
considering a proposal to freeze production
of more cars?
Oil reserves in the country
*168. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:

174
Promotion of In-Flight Service
officers of Indian Airlines
722. SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as per the
agreement between Indian Airlines and Air
Corporation Employees Union it was
agreed that after completion of two years
all In-Flight Service (IFS) officers would
be promoted as Assistant Manager (IFS);
(b) if so, by when all those In-Flight
Service officers would be promoted as
Assistant Manager (IFS);
(c) whether it is also a fact that as per
the agreement all officers of 9A Grade in all
departments, other than the department of
IFS, have been promoted;
(d) if so, by when all officers of the
Department of IFS would be promoted; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Hike in fuel surcharge by domestic
airlines
723. SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether most of the domestic
airlines are contemplating a hike in fuel
surcharge levied on each ticket; and
(b) if so, what is the basis and the extent
of hike?
 Airport Economic Regulatory
Authority Bill
724. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is in process of setting up of Airport
Economic Regulatory Authority;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that a draft
Bill is ready for introduction in Parliament
on the above regulator; and
(d) if so, what are the salient features of
the proposed Bill?
 Requirement of aircrafts
†725. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the number of aircrafts likely to be
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

175
required for passenger and freight transport
for next ten years;
(b) the procedure for procurement of
these aircrafts such as on lease, purchase
etc. and in what manner the funds would
be arranged for that; and
(c) the arrangements being made in this
regard?
 Special air facilities for foreign
tourists
726. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is considering to introduce a special facility
during air-travel in order to attract foreign
tourists;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the likely number of foreign tourists
visiting India annually after extension of
the said facility?
 National Fund for Airport
Development
727. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government has
created the National Fund for Airport
Development for the purpose of supporting
the Bangalore International Airport that is
under implementation as also the Advance
Development Fee Rules in this regard;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether rules laying down the
modalities for passing on the fee collected
in respect of the Bangalore International
Airport are yet to be framed; and
(d) if so, the details and the present
status thereof ?
 Role of private operators for security
at airports
728. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government plans to
depend on private operators for security
of the airports at different places;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether it is considered safe
particularly in view of increasing terrorism
all over the world and particularly in our
country?
 Speedy exit check for foreign air-
passengers
729. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to work out
a mechanism that will allow fast clearance
to foreign passengers at the immigration
counter, thus cutting the waiting time from
90 minutes to barely 10 minutes;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what is the action plan of
Government to guard against anything
adverse against an India-bound foreign
national during this hasty clearance
process?

176
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
 X-ray machines for security at
airport
730. SHRI MAHMOOD A.
MADANI:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has standard
security systems at different airports in
the country particularly in metros; and
(b) whether it is the usual practice to
keep standby X-ray machines in the
security hold area at all the airports?
 International airport at
Visakhapatnam
731. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:

a site to construct the new International
Airport at Visakhapatnam;
(b) if so
